% Pattern: env/command. The paper numbers its paragraphs with an untitled
% theorem environment, and writes each one with a command that opens and
% closes the environment with nothing in it. Seen in the gold pilot (set E).
% want lem-1 statement/lemma 1.1
% want sta-1 unknown 1.2
% want sta-2 unknown 1.3
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{lem}{Lemma}[section]
\newtheorem{sta}[lem]{}
\def\st { \begin{sta} \ \end{sta}}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{lem}
Every compact space is bounded.
\end{lem}

\st  We will usually consider rings that are finitely generated.

\st
A special place is held by rings in positive characteristic.
\end{document}
